all_model_artifacts_untouched: No model is loaded or fitted by this script.

policy.candidate_context_policy: A target requires real eligible moisture for every day from D-lookback through D. Historical context may come from its own partition or the preceding unscored buffer; never from another non-gap partition. No imputation. All four treatments on a date share the same assignment.
policy.cut_selection: Sort eligible daily-pair target dates. Use floor(0.70*N) for training and floor(0.15*N) for validation; remainder test. Apply globally or within each management phase. Set cutoff at the last target date in each initial allocation.
policy.purpose: Compare category coverage and data allocation before a new model experiment. Do not alter the original dataset/model or choose boundaries using target values or scores.
policy.test_status: All candidate data comes from the previously exposed site/sequence; none is a fresh independent final test.

variants.global_chronological_70_15_15: One global training block followed by validation and test with three-day unscored buffers. Forecast-oriented, but cannot contain every unique phase in every partition.
variants.original_v1: Existing frozen global chronological split; preserve its stricter same-partition history rule and existing pair counts.
variants.phase_balanced_70_15_15: Within each phase: early 70% training, middle 15% validation, final 15% test, with three-day buffers. Historical phase-coverage experiment only; globally later training phases occur after earlier validation/test dates.
